subject: Pollination Contract Request for Martinez & Sons Orchards
body_text:
Hi there! 

I'm reaching out to request a clear pollination contract for our upcoming blueberry bloom this season at Martinez & Sons Orchards. We’re looking for 20 hives, same as last year, to cover our 10-acre block. Ideally, we’d like the hives to arrive on April 15th, but we're open to a split delivery if necessary. 

Please send over the contract details at your earliest convenience so we can finalize everything. Thanks for your help! 

Best,  
Robert Dominguez
